text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't change any tests. Here are the fixes, all in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is 5 instead of 3, matching the comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` multiplied by the daily fee in the wrong way. It added `DAILY_FEE` to the days late. It now multiplies.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` sliced `[-n - 1:]` and returned one event too many. It now slices `[-n:]`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the `Emma` book, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count aren't specified anywhere, so I picked them to match the test data in `tests/test_search.py`.
